## About
European Collision Works is a family owned and operated auto body, collision, and paint repair shop on North Shore Road in Revere. We restore foreign and domestic vehicles to pre-accident factory condition.
We specialize in insurance repair work, and we always work for our customers, not for any insurance company. We design a repair plan around what you need, then take care of payments, insurance negotiations, rental car and towing arrangements along the way.
Customers know Rob and his crew by name. One reviewer wrote that Marilyn was very helpful working with her insurance company and arranging her rental car.

## Services
- Body work and collision repair: Repairs for foreign and domestic vehicles, back to pre-accident condition.
- Free estimates: Stop by and we'll look at the damage with you.
- Customer pickup and delivery: We can pick up your vehicle and bring it back to you.
- Rental car and towing arrangements: We set up the tow and the rental so you're not stuck.
- Computerized color matching system and custom paint: Paint matched by computer, plus custom paint work.
- Paintless dent removal: Dents pulled out without repainting the panel.
- Complimentary detailing with repairs: Your vehicle comes back cleaned up along with the repair.
- Lifetime warranty on all paint and body work: Our paint and body work is covered for life.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Please come in for an estimate any time during our hours.

Q: Will you deal with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We handle payments, insurance negotiations and the incidentals. One reviewer said they worked with Geico to get their car to us.

Q: Do you only work on European cars?
A: No. We restore both foreign and domestic vehicles to pre-accident condition.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
